name: Future UI
summary: Animated React component library: carousels, cards, bento grids, WebGL backgrounds, effects, inputs and buttons.
description: An animated component library grouped into carousels, cards, blocks, displays, backgrounds, effects, inputs and buttons: 3D and drag carousels, particle and shader cards, bento grids, a fluid navbar, a revolving sidebar, retro LED and split-flap displays, WebGL2 backgrounds, hover effects, an accordion, a tooltip and four buttons. Components ship as TypeScript for React and Tailwind CSS, copied by hand or installed with the shadcn CLI; there is a free tier and a $199 one-time all-access purchase that adds every component and the full-page templates.
contains: components grouped into carousels, cards, blocks, displays, backgrounds, effects, inputs and buttons
3D and WebGL2 pieces: radial carousel, isometric cube grid, shader cards, 10+ animated backgrounds
free components plus a $199 one-time all-access purchase
copy-paste code or shadcn CLI installs (React + TypeScript + Tailwind)
